Q: why do need multiple from clauses in a docker file? A:

why cannot just compile the application and then use an ordinary docker file using only one FROM clause?

You could, and many projects do.

But by performing the build step inside a container, you have more control over the build environment, and are less affected by whatever host you're doing the build on. You don't need any particular development software to be installed on the host, and it will work the same way whether it's being built from your machine, my machine, or some headless automated build environment where installing extra software is a pain...

Q: How to get the font style from an image with text? A:

There is an open source library called Mixfont Lens on Github that can help with identifying the closest open source (Google Font) from your images. It's also available as a font recognition API commercially.

Q: button Element doesn't work on Iphones for some reason A:

<button> acts as a submit in a form by default. For the fix I would give "type="button" for example:

<button type="button" id="aufloesen">buttontext</button>
